description.value: Pelican Rouge Cafe is a White Rock coffee shop serving drinks and food under the Pelican Rouge brand, which claims over 150 years of European coffee craftsmanship. The café offers both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a comfortable stop in the South Surrey area. Online ordering is available for takeout pickup.

address.value: 15142 North Bluff Road, White Rock, BC V4B 5M1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Pelican Rouge Cafe is a real, operating coffee-focused café at 15142 North Bluff Road, White Rock, BC, with an active online ordering system and phone number (604) 541-8778. The OSM record places it in the Tsawwassen community, but the website explicitly says 'WHITEROCK'S BEST CAFE' and gives a White Rock address — a location discrepancy flagged in concerns. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags; takeout is confirmed via the online ordering system.
concerns: Location mismatch: OSM community is listed as Tsawwassen, but the website states the address is 15142 North Bluff Road, White Rock, BC — the OSM node may be placed in the wrong community.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating café with an active website and online ordering system; a useful stop for touring cyclists in the White Rock/South Surrey area.
